release.content: pubdeploy 0.5.1 was released on 2026-11-18 from commit 71b6fa9349bbf9a9c5506d0e40dad3080cce9e82 with these changes.

rows: pubdeploy machine prints a unit's needs as a state machine (a documented subset of XState v5 JSON, which python-statemachine runs too: machine.load); the deploy block's run section (schema 1: default_mode, parallel, a need's mode and after-edges) may only narrow the generated default, and pubrules sync --check checks it; need types say serial and stop (signal, shorten, continue with a stop_warning); walk --need ID walks, and with --fulfil fulfils, only those needs, refusing when one they wait for is not ready; --budget-seconds caps a check or a fulfil

pubdeploy machine --mode fulfil sets only the run section's default_mode and keeps its per-need modes (--mode check still makes every need a check, --modes is over both); a need the walk could not judge ends in a final unknown state (guard is_unknown) instead of blocked; a walk's check or fulfil is waited for in slices, and SIGUSR1 (a live run's Stop that shortens) ends the running one as unknown, keeping the journal
